name: Lifeline phone or internet discount
description: Money off your phone or internet bill each month, if you qualify.
eligibility: Income at or below 135% of poverty, or receiving SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, federal public housing or a veterans pension. One per household.

steps: Apply online with the National Verifier. Or ask your phone company.
documents: Proof of SNAP, Medicaid or SSI, or proof of income
